# Django Insurance Lab — Structured Audit

**Project root:** `C:\Users\khala\.cursor\projects\empty-window`  
**App:** `insurance` · **Project:** `insurance_site`

---

## 1. URL routes — FBV vs CBV

**Root** (`C:\Users\khala\.cursor\projects\empty-window\insurance_site\urls.py`):

| Path | Handler |
|------|---------|
| `/admin/` | Django admin |
| `/accounts/*` | `django.contrib.auth.urls` (login/logout/password flows) |
| `/*` | `insurance.urls` |

**Insurance app** (`C:\Users\khala\.cursor\projects\empty-window\insurance\urls.py`) — **all routes are CBV** (`.as_view()`). **No function-based views** in the app.

| URL pattern | Name | View class | Module |
|-------------|------|------------|--------|
| `""` | `home` | `SiteHomeView` (TemplateView) | `site_pages.py` |
| `about/` | `about` | `AboutView` | `site_pages.py` |
| `news/` | `news-list` | `NewsListView` | `site_pages.py` |
| `news/<slug>/` | `news-detail` | `NewsDetailView` | `site_pages.py` |
| `faq/` | `faq-list` | `FAQListView` | `site_pages.py` |
| `contacts/` | `contact-list` | `ContactListView` | `site_pages.py` |
| `privacy/` | `privacy` | `PrivacyView` | `site_pages.py` |
| `vacancies/` | `vacancy-list` | `VacancyListView` | `site_pages.py` |
| `reviews/` | `review-list` | `ReviewListView` | `site_pages.py` |
| `reviews/add/` | `review-add` | `ReviewCreateView` | `site_pages.py` |
| `promos/` | `promo-list` | `PromoListView` | `site_pages.py` |
| `register/` | `register` | `RegisterView` | `site_pages.py` |
| `my/` | `client-dashboard` | `ClientDashboardView` | `portal_views.py` |
| `my/profile/create/` | `client-profile-create` | `ClientProfileCreateView` | `portal_views.py` |
| `my/profile/edit/` | `client-profile-edit` | `ClientProfileUpdateView` | `portal_views.py` |
| `my/contracts/add/` | `client-contract-add` | `ClientPortalContractCreateView` | `portal_views.py` |
| `staff/` | `employee-dashboard` | `EmployeeDashboardView` | `portal_views.py` |
| `staff/contracts/` | `employee-contract-list` | `EmployeeContractListView` | `portal_views.py` |
| `stats/dashboard/` | `stats-dashboard` | `StatsDashboardView` | `stats_views.py` |
| `api/stats/charts/` | `stats-charts-json` | `StatsChartsJsonView` (View) | `stats_views.py` |
| `api/branch/<pk>/weather/` | `api-branch-weather` | `BranchWeatherJsonView` | `api_views.py` |
| `api/holidays/<year>/` | `api-holidays` | `PublicHolidaysJsonView` | `api_views.py` |
| `branches/` … `branches/<pk>/delete/` | branch CRUD | `Branch*View` | `views.py` |
| `insurance-types/` … | insurance type CRUD | `InsuranceType*View` | `views.py` |
| `agents/` … | agent CRUD | `Agent*View` | `views.py` |
| `clients/` … | client CRUD | `Client*View` | `views.py` |
| `insured-objects/` … | insured object CRUD | `InsuredObject*View` | `views.py` |
| `contracts/` … | contract CRUD | `Contract*View` | `views.py` |

**Gap vs typical lab:** rubrics often require **both FBV and CBV**; this project is **100% CBV** (including JSON endpoints as `View` subclasses).

---

## 2. Templates — `base.html`, images

**45 HTML files** under `C:\Users\khala\.cursor\projects\empty-window\insurance\templates\`.

| Extends `insurance/base.html`? | Files |
|--------------------------------|-------|
| **Yes (44)** | All page templates + `registration/login.html` |
| **No (1)** | `insurance/_pagination.html` (include partial only) |

**Base layout:** `C:\Users\khala\.cursor\projects\empty-window\insurance\templates\insurance\base.html` — plain HTML nav, no Bootstrap/CSS framework.

**Images on pages** (external URLs, not `MEDIA` uploads):

| Template | Source |
|----------|--------|
| `home.html` | `latest_news.image_url` |
| `news_list.html`, `news_detail.html` | `article.image_url` |
| `contact_list.html` | `c.photo_url` |

Models: `NewsArticle.image_url`, `ContactPerson.photo_url` (`models.py`). Seed uses `picsum.photos` URLs.

**Gap:** no `ImageField` / local media; assignment may expect uploaded images.

---

## 3. Models — validators, timezone, DOB

**File:** `C:\Users\khala\.cursor\projects\empty-window\insurance\models.py`  
**Validators module:** `C:\Users\khala\.cursor\projects\empty-window\insurance\validators.py`

| Validation | Where |
|------------|--------|
| Belarus phone `+375 (29) XXX-XX-XX` | `validate_by_mobile_phone` on `Branch.phone`, `Agent.phone`, `Client.phone`, `ContactPerson.phone` |
| Age ≥ 18 | `validate_age_at_least_18` in `Agent.clean()`, `Client.clean()`, `ContactPerson.clean()` |
| Tariff / commission bounds | `MinValueValidator` / `MaxValueValidator` on `InsuranceType`, `InsuredObject.value`, `Contract.insurance_amount`, `Review.rating`, `PromoCode.discount_percent` |
| Contract dates | `end_date >= signed_date`; agent branch must match contract branch |
| Promo dates | `valid_until >= valid_from` |

**Timezone-related fields:**

- Abstract `TimeStampedModel`: `created_at`, `updated_at` (`DateTimeField`, auto)
- `NewsArticle.published_at` — `DateTimeField(default=timezone.now)`
- Business dates: `DateField` only (`birth_date`, `signed_date`, `end_date`, promo dates)

**Settings** (`C:\Users\khala\.cursor\projects\empty-window\insurance_site\settings.py`):

```122:124:C:\Users\khala\.cursor\projects\empty-window\insurance_site\settings.py
TIME_ZONE = "UTC"
USE_I18N = True
USE_TZ = True
```

Stats page shows UTC server time + browser local time via inline JS (`stats_dashboard.html`).

**Gap:** `TIME_ZONE` is **UTC**, not `Europe/Minsk` (common Belarus lab expectation).

**DOB gap:** `Model.clean()` runs on full model validation; forms are `ModelForm` — age rules apply when `full_clean()` runs. No separate form-level age validator beyond model `clean()`.

---

## 4. External API usage

| Service | File | Endpoint |
|---------|------|----------|
| **Nominatim** (geocode) | `insurance/services/nominatim.py` | `https://nominatim.openstreetmap.org/search` |
| **Open-Meteo** (weather) | `insurance/services/open_meteo.py` | `https://api.open-meteo.com/v1/forecast` |
| **Nager.Date** (holidays) | `insurance/services/nager_holidays.py` | `https://date.nager.at/api/v3/PublicHolidays/{year}/{country}` |
| HTTP helper | `insurance/services/http.py` | `urllib` (no `requests`) |
| Orchestration | `insurance/services/branch_weather.py` | geocode + weather |

**Exposure:**

- **HTML:** branch detail (authenticated) — `BranchDetailView` calls `weather_for_branch`
- **JSON:** `api/branch/<pk>/weather/` (`BranchWeatherJsonView`, login required)
- **JSON:** `api/holidays/<year>/` (`PublicHolidaysJsonView`, login required, default country `BY`)
- Stats page links to holidays JSON

**Gap:** three external integrations (good for “2+ APIs”); weather needs login for JSON; branch HTML weather only when user is authenticated.

---

## 5. Frontend search / sort

| Location | Mechanism |
|----------|-----------|
| `portal/employee_contract_list.html` + `EmployeeContractListView` | **Server-side** GET `q` (search) and `sort` (signed date / amount asc/desc) — HTML `<form>`, not AJAX |
| Other CRM list templates (`contract_list.html`, `client_list.html`, etc.) | Pagination only via `_pagination.html`; **no search/sort** |
| `stats_dashboard.html` | Inline JS: timezone label, `fetch()` Chart.js data |

**No** client-side JS filtering/sorting on main entity lists.

**Gap:** if lab requires JS table search/sort on main CRUD lists, only the employee portal contract page qualifies.

---

## 6. Stats / charts

| Layer | Technology |
|-------|------------|
| Server aggregates | Python `statistics` in `insurance/stats.py` (`mean`, `median`, `multimode`) |
| Dashboard | `StatsDashboardView` — tables, calendar text, mean/median/mode, popular/profitable types |
| Charts | **Chart.js 4.4.1** (CDN) in `stats_dashboard.html`, data from `StatsChartsJsonView` |
| Matplotlib | **Not used** (not in `requirements.txt`, no imports) |

Three charts: contracts by type (bar), premiums by type (bar), premiums by month (line).

---

## 7. CRUD — entities, FBV vs CBV, access

**All frontend CRUD is CBV** (`CreateView` / `UpdateView` / `DeleteView` / `ListView` / `DetailView` in `views.py`, `site_pages.py`, `portal_views.py`).

| Entity | Frontend CRUD | View module | Access notes |
|--------|---------------|-------------|--------------|
| **Branch** | Full | `views.py` | List/detail **public**; create/update/delete **`EmployeeOrSuperuserMixin`** |
| **InsuranceType** | Full | `views.py` | Same pattern |
| **Agent** | Full | `views.py` | All CRM routes employee/superuser |
| **Client** | Full | `views.py` | Employee/superuser |
| **InsuredObject** | Full | `views.py` | Employee/superuser |
| **Contract** | Full | `views.py` | Employee/superuser; detail uses **`ContractAccessMixin`** (client sees own) |
| **Review** | Create + list | `site_pages.py` | Create: logged-in **`client`** group |
| **Client profile** | Create/update | `portal_views.py` | **`client`** group |
| **Contract (portal)** | Create only | `portal_views.py` | Client orders contract; agent auto-picked |
| **CMS** (news, FAQ, contacts, vacancies, promos, company) | Read-only on site | `site_pages.py` | **Admin only** for write |
| **User registration** | Create | `site_pages.RegisterView` | Public → adds to **`client`** group |

**Gap:** no FBV CRUD; CMS has no public CRUD (admin-only).

---

## 8. Auth — login, registration, groups

| Feature | Implementation |
|---------|----------------|
| Login | `accounts/login/` → `registration/login.html` extends base; `LOGIN_URL` = `/accounts/login/` |
| Logout | POST form in `base.html` → `logout` |
| Registration | `/register/` — `UserCreationForm`, auto **`Group` `client`** (`site_pages.py`) |
| Employee group | `EmployeeOrSuperuserMixin` checks `employee` group or superuser |
| Context | `insurance/context_processors.py` — `show_crm_tools`, `is_client_group` |

**Groups in seed:** `client`, `employee` created (`seed_data.py`); **no demo users** assigned to `employee` — must use admin/superuser or manual group assignment.

**Gap:** no custom password-reset templates (Django defaults under `/accounts/`); employee users not seeded.

---

## 11. Possibly “extra” for lab defense

Useful but beyond minimal lab scope:

- Large **pytest** suite (`insurance/tests/`, `.coveragerc`)
- **`ClientIdentity`** + **`PromoCode`** models and pages
- **`privacy.html`**, promo archive/active split
- **Three** external APIs + dedicated service layer
- **Docker/Gunicorn/WhiteNoise/PostgreSQL** + `DEPLOY_AND_GIT.md`
- **Chart.js** + JSON stats API + Python mean/median/mode
- Employee dashboard + duplicate contract list with search
- **No Bootstrap** (aligned with deploy doc’s “bootstrap branch later” note)
- urllib HTTP client instead of `requests`
- Branch/insurance-type **public** read without login

---
